name: Dynodoc Document Version Control Agent
description: Workflow manager and version control agent for documents, spreadsheets, and presentations. Manages hash-chained revisions, drafts, and branch merges.

skills.name: Get Document History
skills.description: Inspect tamper-evident SHA-256 event chains, author signatures, and commit records.
examples: Verify event chain integrity for quarterly-budget.xlsx

skills.name: Diff Revisions
skills.description: Compute structural paragraph and cell diffs across document versions.
examples: Diff revision v1.4 and v1.5 of legal-agreement.docx

skills.name: Stage Branch Merge
skills.description: Prepare review drafts and conflict resolution choices with human confirmation.
examples: Stage merge from feature/annex-b into main

skills.name: Sync Workspace
skills.description: Reconcile local repository changes with PostgreSQL storage and team workspaces.
examples: Sync pending offline drafts to team repository
